images.filename: SAN Rock Art Colonial Male Figure, Diep Kloof Rock Shelter, Western Cape.JPG
images.caption: Painting of colonial figure, Diep Kloof Rock Shelter, Elands Bay, Western Cape, South Africa.  The feathered hat indicates a colonial figure probably of the Dutch period.  The large phallus is believed to indicate the perceived power of the individual.  The rock painting in in the tradition of the San or Bushman people.
